metadata.title: @capgo/capacitor-widget-kit
metadata.description: Build iOS WidgetKit and Live Activity surfaces from Capacitor with SVG frame templates, timers, action hotspots, and a full-native widget bridge.

hero.tagline: WidgetKit and Live Activities for Capacitor apps, with SVG-driven templates or full-native widget state sync.

blocks.text: gives a Capacitor app two ways to drive widgets and Live Activities:
SVG template activities: define WidgetKit surfaces as SVG, switch named frames from taps, run pause/play timers, mutate JSON state, and collect action events in the app.
Full-native widget sessions: keep the widget UI fully in Swift/Kotlin/Java while Capacitor owns shared JSON state and app-to-widget or widget-to-app messages.

Use SVG templates when your widget can be rendered from resolved SVG strings. Use full-native sessions when the widget needs a custom native UI but still has to start, stop, sync state, or ask the app to complete async work.

props.alt: Animated WidgetKit demo showing template widget state and controls driven from Capacitor

blocks.text: Live Activities or widget surfaces that render from SVG output
Native-rendered widgets that need shared state and async jobs

Both modes can live in the same app. For example, a workout app can use an SVG Live Activity for fast frame/timer controls and a full-native widget session for a home-screen widget with a richer native layout.
SVG templates include the pieces needed for interactive widget surfaces:
hold named SVG variants such as
switch, toggle, or step through frames after a hotspot action.
start, pause, resume, toggle, reset, stop, or change timer duration.
update JSON state using literal values, templates, timestamps, increments, toggles, or unset operations.
map tap areas to action identifiers.
lets the app process widget-originated actions later.
before the native bridge returns a surface for rendering.
Full-native sessions are for widgets that render their own UI natively:
creates shared state and metadata for native widget code.
merges or replaces state and marks the session active again.
records a final state and marks the session stopped.
stores a response or failure for async jobs.
Messages are idempotent after completion: retrying a completed or failed message returns the existing result instead of overwriting it.
Check whether the native template activity bridge can run on the current device.
Persist an SVG template activity and start the native Live Activity bridge.
Replace the activity definition, state, or open URL.
End a running activity and optionally persist one last state snapshot.
Execute declarative patches, frame mutations, timer mutations, and event logging.
Read action events emitted by template actions.
Start a full-native widget session backed by shared JSON state.
Merge or replace a full-native widget session state.
Stop a full-native widget session and optionally persist final state.
Queue a message between the app and native widget code.
Complete or fail an async bridge message.
Return the platform implementation version marker.
The plugin also ships native helpers for widget targets:
resolves an SVG template surface into
connects interactive iOS widget buttons to template actions.
loads full-native sessions and messages from native widget code.
Android template helpers provide matching action receiver and widget bridge behavior.
